text_spans.text: Belt Overview: Twelve Candidate Transects Located
The extent is a constraint; the collaboration loop is the
main story.
Shared Partition: Same Edges, Zero Gaps, Zero
Overlaps
Complete coverage supports recalculation, not statutory
zoning or parcels.
Three Key Areas at One Comparative Scale
Zhongzhiyuan validates, AI Origin translates, and
Dazhongsi hosts public trials; all three boundaries are
provisional.
Responsibility Transects: Twelve Candidates, Three
Detailed
All twelve CX candidates remain unsurveyed; only CX02,
CX05, and CX10 receive relational design targets.
Evidence + Metrics: Adverse Results Stay Visible
Twenty-one metrics are known, six remain unknown, and
nineteen are independently recomputable; adverse results
stay visible.
Identity System: One Belt, Three Interfaces, One
Grammar
The shared language supports recognition, takeover,
verification, and withdrawal without implying official
identity.
AI Innovation Ecosystem: Three Areas + Two Wings
Space, talent, compute, data, scenarios, and governance
form a gated, auditable loop.
Twelve Scenario Protocols: AI Authority + Human
Takeover
Every scenario states what AI may do, what humans alone
decide, how takeover works, the low-tech fallback, and
the exit path.
Three Landmarks + Open Contribution Ledger +
Components
Contributions are reviewable, correctable, and
withdrawable; conceptual components remain reversible,
maintainable, and removable.
Culture + Wayfinding: Time as a Spatial Coordinate
Jing-Zhang rail memory, Zhongguancun innovation, and
transparent AI remain distinct.
Operate, Take Over, Appeal, Stop, and Remove
Nine states, fifteen transitions, the sole SC10+IM06 first
use, complaint and appeal, and thirteen adverse
dispositions jointly constrain exit.
